classification.difficultyReason: 1E Q15: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. The coefficient −1 makes the final double-sided example directly applicable.

content.prompt: Solve the inequality and represent the solution on a number line. $$-5<1-x\le7.$$

answer.worked:
Subtract $1$, then divide by $-1$, reversing both signs.

$$\begin{align*}-6&<-x\le6\\6&>x\ge-6\\-6&\le x<6\end{align*}$$
